rationale: Both Asoma and Kazumasa are materials science researchers at Resonac with complementary expertise: Asoma specializes in computational chemistry and molecular dynamics simulation for polymer materials, while Kazumasa brings semiconductor and materials development experience from both Resonac and Sony. Their work at the intersection of computational methods and materials science could create opportunities for cross-domain collaboration on advanced materials challenges.
intro_message: Asoma Yuichiro, meet Kazumasa Marumo — you're both materials researchers at Resonac with complementary skills in computational simulation and semiconductor/materials development.
